description: This header file defines utility classes and functions for testing within the ocudu namespace, including custom log sinks, test delimiters, test objects for move and copy semantics, a random number generator for tests, and formatting support for moveonly_test_object.

classes.name: log_sink_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that counts error and warning log entries.

classes.name: log_sink_message_spy
classes.description: A custom log sink that stores log entries and allows message search.

classes.name: test_delimit_logger
classes.description: A utility class that outputs delimiters around test logs.

classes.name: moveonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify move semantics, with internal object count tracking.

classes.name: copyonly_test_object
classes.description: A test object to verify copy semantics, with internal object count tracking.

classes.name: nondefault_ctor_test_object
classes.description: A simple test object with a non-default constructor.

classes.name: test_rgen
classes.description: A class providing a reproducible pseudo-random number generator for tests.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the identifier name of the custom sink.

methods.name: get_error_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of error log entries.

methods.name: get_warning_counter
methods.description: Returns the count of warning log entries.

methods.name: reset_counters
methods.description: Resets error and warning counters to zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Processes a log buffer, counts error/warning entries, and forwards to default sink.

methods.name: has_message
methods.description: Checks if a message string exists in stored log entries.

methods.name: test_delimit_logger
methods.description: Outputs formatted delimiters for test start/end.

methods.name: moveonly_test_object
methods.description: A test object with move semantics, internal object count, and value access.

methods.name: copyonly_test_object
methods.description: A test object with copy semantics, internal object count, and value access.

methods.name: nondefault_ctor_test_object
methods.description: A simple test object with a custom constructor.

methods.name: test_rgen
methods.description: Provides thread-local pseudo-random number generation with seed control.
